purpose: Collective organisation models available to farmers for aggregation, input purchase and market access.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
source_tier: Tier 1-2 (Ministry of Agriculture FPO programme; NABARD; MCA; NRLM)
methodology: Five legal and organisational forms were characterised by registration route, typical membership scale and services offered, because the choice between them is a legal-structure decision with different compliance consequences.
known_limitations: Describes organisation types, not a registry of named FPOs. typical_size_members is an indicative band.
